configurations.name: hub-sample
runtimeArgs: cd market-hub-landing && MARKETHUB_SAMPLE_MARKETS=1 MARKETHUB_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn markethub.api:create_app --factory --port 8080

configurations.name: hub-sample-windows
runtimeArgs: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" UV_LINK_MODE=copy; cd market-hub-landing && MARKETHUB_SAMPLE_MARKETS=1 MARKETHUB_OPEN_REGISTRATION=1 MARKETHUB_INSECURE_COOKIES=1 MARKETHUB_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn markethub.api:create_app --factory --port 8080

configurations.name: hub-live-windows
runtimeArgs: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" UV_LINK_MODE=copy; cd market-hub-landing && MARKETHUB_SAMPLE_NEWS=1 MARKETHUB_INSECURE_COOKIES=1 MARKETHUB_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn markethub.api:create_app --factory --port 8081

configurations.name: hub-live
runtimeArgs: cd market-hub-landing && MARKETHUB_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn markethub.api:create_app --factory --port 8081

configurations.name: fundamentals-local
runtimeArgs: cd fundamentals-lab && HUB_URL= FUNDAMENTALS_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn fundamentals.api:create_app --factory --port 8082

configurations.name: radar-local
runtimeArgs: cd decision-signal-lab && HUB_URL= RADAR_STATIC_DIR=site/dist uv run uvicorn decisionsignal.api:create_app --factory --port 8083

configurations.name: mobile-api
runtimeArgs: cd market-hub-landing && ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= MARKETHUB_SAMPLE_MARKETS=1 MARKETHUB_SAMPLE_NEWS=1 MARKETHUB_OPEN_REGISTRATION=1 MARKETHUB_INSECURE_COOKIES=1 MARKETHUB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:8090 MARKETHUB_DATA_DIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/market-hub-mobile-data uv run uvicorn markethub.api:create_app --factory --port 8000

configurations.name: mobile-web
runtimeArgs: cd market-hub-mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 npx expo start --web --port 8090
